scenario.title: 推薦影集、講劇情不爆雷
scenario.context: 講劇情時常要說「在那之前，他早就已經…」：她發現的時候，他已經離開了。這種「過去的過去」就是過去完成式（had + p.p.）的用途。學會它，講故事的時間線才不會亂。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Have you watched the new season of that detective show?
lines.zh: 你看了那部偵探劇的新一季嗎？

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I binge-watched the whole thing this weekend. No regrets.
lines.zh: 我這週末一口氣全看完了，毫不後悔。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: I'm only on episode three. No spoilers!
lines.zh: 我才看到第三集。不准爆雷！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I won't. But the plot twist in episode six… wow.
lines.zh: 我不會。但第六集的劇情反轉……哇。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Stop! Just tell me if it's worth it.
lines.zh: 停！告訴我值不值得看就好。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Totally. I had never seen a show do that before.
lines.zh: 絕對值得，我從來沒看過有劇這樣處理。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: I finished it! I can't believe the detective had known the whole time.
lines.zh: 我看完了！真不敢相信那個偵探一直都知道。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Right? By the time his partner figured it out, he had already destroyed the evidence.
lines.zh: 對吧？等他搭檔發現的時候，他早就把證據毀掉了。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: And the scene where his daughter finds the letter he had written years ago…
lines.zh: 還有他女兒發現他多年前寫的那封信那一幕……

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: I cried so hard. It was such a tearjerker.

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Same. I hadn't cried at a show in years.
lines.zh: 我也是，我已經好幾年沒看劇哭了。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: We need another show to watch. Any ideas?
lines.zh: 我們需要新的劇來追。有想法嗎？

patterns.en: It's a bit slow at first, but it gets better.
patterns.zh: 一開始有點慢，但後面越來越好看。

patterns.en: It's based on a true story.
patterns.zh: 它是根據真實故事改編的。

patterns.en: I'd give it an 8 out of 10.
patterns.zh: 我給它 10 分裡的 8 分。

chinglish.wrong: When his partner found out, he already destroyed the evidence.
chinglish.right: When his partner found out, he had already destroyed the evidence.
chinglish.why: 兩件過去的事，先發生的那件要用過去完成式，時間順序才會清楚。中文靠「已經」「早就」，英文靠 had + p.p.。

chinglish.right: Don't spoil it for me! / No spoilers!
chinglish.why: spoil me 是「寵我」。爆雷要說 spoil it (for me)。

chinglish.wrong: This drama is very touching my heart.
chinglish.right: This show is so touching. / This show really got to me.
chinglish.why: touching 是形容詞，不能後面接受詞。另外美式口語把影集叫 show，drama 指的是「劇情類」。

chinglish.wrong: I chase this drama every week.
chinglish.right: I'm following this show. / I'm watching it every week.
chinglish.why: 「追劇」直翻 chase 不通，用 follow / watch / keep up with。

grammar.title: 過去完成式
grammar.oneLiner: had + p.p.：兩件過去的事裡，比較早發生的那一件用過去完成式。
whenToUse: 過去的過去：When I arrived, the movie had started.（電影先開始，我才到）
常搭配：by the time, already, before, after, never…before。
間接引述裡的時態後退：He said he had seen it.（第 36 單元會詳講）
經驗到過去某時為止：I had never seen anything like it (before that).
如果用 before / after 已經把順序講清楚，口語常直接用過去式：I left after he arrived.
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「早就」「已經」可以放在任何時態裡，動詞不用改。英文說故事時，主要事件用過去式，更早的事情要再往前推一格，改用 had + p.p.。台灣人講故事常把所有事都用過去式，聽的人就搞不清楚順序，尤其是劇情有倒敘的時候。

examples.correct: By the time I got home, my roommate had eaten all the pizza.
examples.incorrect: By the time I got home, my roommate ate all the pizza.

examples.correct: I had never watched a K-drama before I moved to Seoul.
examples.note: 到過去某時為止的經驗。

examples.correct: She realized she had left her phone at the café.
examples.note: 先把手機留在咖啡店，後來才發現。

examples.correct: The show had already ended when I turned on the TV.
examples.note: already 放 had 和 p.p. 中間。

examples.correct: After I finished the book, I watched the movie.
examples.note: 有 after 標明順序，用過去式就可以。

quiz.question: When we got to the theater, the movie ___.
quiz.explanation: 電影先開始，用過去完成式。

quiz.question: I ___ never seen such a good ending before that show.
quiz.explanation: 到過去某時為止的經驗，用 had。

quiz.question: She was upset because someone ___ the ending.
quiz.explanation: 爆雷在她難過之前發生。

quiz.question: By the time I finished season one, my friends had ___ (watch) all three seasons.
I realized I ___ that episode before.

slang.usage: 名詞 spoiler；spoiler alert = 以下有雷。動詞 spoil it (for someone)。

examples.en: Spoiler alert: the dog doesn't die.
Don't read the comments. They're full of spoilers.

slang.usage: binge = 暴飲暴食般地大量做某事。也可以只說 binge：I binged the whole series.

examples.en: I binge-watched eight episodes last night.
examples.zh: 我昨晚一口氣看了八集。

examples.en: It's the perfect show to binge on a rainy weekend.
examples.zh: 這部很適合下雨的週末一口氣追完。

slang.usage: 故事出乎意料的轉折，也用來開玩笑形容生活中的意外：Plot twist: he was single the whole time.

examples.en: Nobody saw that plot twist coming.
examples.zh: 沒人料到那個劇情反轉。

examples.en: Plot twist: the client loved the first draft after all.
examples.zh: 劇情反轉：客戶最後還是喜歡初稿。

slang.meaning: 催淚作品、賺人熱淚的片
slang.usage: 讓人哭的電影、劇、歌、故事。jerk = 猛拉，把眼淚拉出來。

examples.en: Bring tissues. It's a real tearjerker.
I don't usually like tearjerkers, but this one was beautiful.
examples.zh: 我通常不喜歡催淚片，但這部很美。

review.question: It's the show ___ everyone's talking about.
review.explanation: 複習第 31 單元：指物用 that。

review.question: He stopped replying after two dates. He totally ___ me.
I ___ three seasons so far.
review.explanation: 複習第 30 單元：so far 用現在完成式。

review.question: I ___ the finale when my phone rang.
review.explanation: 複習第 28 單元：被打斷的背景用過去進行式。

review.question: My sister ___ me watch the whole series with her.
review.explanation: 複習第 24 單元：make + 人 + 原形。

review.question: It's my ___ favorite show. (我表姊的)
No ___! I haven't seen the last episode yet.
